parameters.query:

VALUES ($1, $2, 'DRAFT', $3)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO case_validations (case_id, ruleset_version, is_valid, errors)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
UPDATE cases SET status = $1 WHERE id = $2
